acceptance.criterion: relative error of the measured decay exponent vs the closed-form Navier-Stokes value

decision: D1: for 3-D bulk (periodic) viscous-transport work, which collision selection should TensorLBM adopt as default - and is the choice material inside the owner 15 % band? Arms: BGK (Qian-d'Humieres-Lallemand 1992), TRT with magic Lambda = 3/16 (Ginzburg 2005; Ginzburg-Verhaeghe-d'Humieres 2008), MRT with the recorded TensorLBM rates s_e=1.19, s_eps=1.4, s_q=1.2, s_pi=1.19 (d'Humieres 1992; Lallemand-Luo 2000), and regularised BGK (Latt-Chopard 2006), crossed with the initial-condition protocol (equilibrium-only vs equilibrium + first-order viscous stress, the CASE-TAYLOR-GREEN-3D round-2 lesson) at two resolutions.
alternatives: ALT-A (operator effect): the four collision operators differ by >= 15 % on the primary KPI at matched N, i.e. the operator choice is the dominant error term.
ALT-B (IC effect): all operators agree inside the band, but the IC protocol shifts the KPI by >= 15 % (or by more than the operator spread) - the IC, not the operator, is the selection knob.
ALT-C (both inside the band): every arm at N >= 32 is inside 15 % of the exact solution, so the selection is a stability/cost question rather than an accuracy question. Reported honestly if measured.

case.name: ABC (Arnold-Beltrami-Childress) Beltrami flow, exact unsteady Navier-Stokes solution
case.initial_field: u = A (sin k z + cos k y, sin k x + cos k z, sin k y + cos k x), k = 2 pi / N
case.why_exact: curl u = k u (Beltrami), hence (u.grad)u = grad(|u|^2/2) is absorbed by the pressure and NS reduces to du/dt = nu lap u = -nu k^2 u
external_anchor: Dombre et al. (1986), J. Fluid Mech. 167, 353 - ABC/Beltrami flows and their exactness
Childress (1970), J. Math. Phys. 11, 3063 - ABC kinematic dynamo (flow definition)
CASE-TAYLOR-GREEN-3D (this repo, docs/CASE_TAYLOR_GREEN_3D.md) - same closed form, machine-checked |curl u - k u| / |curl u| = 2.1e-15
Kruger et al. (2017), The Lattice Boltzmann Method, Springer ch. 8 - viscosity recovery from a decaying Fourier mode

protocol.fit_window: from 20 % of the run to the end, least squares on ln A_proj(t)
protocol.kpi_primary: err_nu_pct = 100 * (nu_fit - nu) / nu, nu = (tau - 1/2)/3, nu_fit = -slope / k^2
kpi_secondary: l2_rel field error vs the exact field at the last step
protocol.stability_rung: tau = 0.505 at N = 32: survival of 2400 steps + the same decay-exponent KPI
protocol.budget_note: hard 120 s single-command cap: one grid (N=16), one IC protocol (viscous-stress 'tau'), 120 steps, plus a 30-step low-tau (0.505) stability rung. The two-grid/two-IC matrix of the first predeclaration is NOT executed - recorded as an open item, not as a pass.

stopping_rule: any arm producing non-finite fields is recorded as a measured failure (status=diverged) and excluded from the accuracy table; no tolerance is changed after the runs.
